items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: So we hired him. He lived up on Rampart Street at that time. And we had to go up and get him out of the room to bring him to work for you.

ctx.x: I know, I think that... It's either Louis Armstrong or Baby Dodds that talks about him and has such a beautiful tone.
That's right. He played on the boat at the time that Louis Armstrong played. He was a mellophone player. I've known the instrument. We haven't had one since.
What did the people like to dance to in those times, in the Sydneys times, before you ever had the capital?
